import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Define more descriptive variable names for the columns
composite_deprivation_score = 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).1'
population_affected_percentage = 'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).3'

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(df[composite_deprivation_score], df[population_affected_percentage])
plt.title('Correlation between Composite Deprivation Score and Population Affected Percentage')
plt.xlabel('Composite Deprivation Score')
plt.ylabel('Population Affected Percentage')
plt.tight_layout()
# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Composite Deprivation Score', 'y_fields': ['Population Affected Percentage'], 'chart_type': 'scatterChart'}
plt.show()
